question: Who among the following won the Asian Billiards title for the 8th time in the 19th Asian 100 UP Billiards Championship 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Advani. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• At the **19th Asian 100 UP Billiards Championship 2022, **Indian cueist **Pankaj Advani** defeated **Dhruv Sitwala **to win his **eighth championship.**
 
• The location was** Doha, Qatar.**
 
• This was Advani's **eighth Asian championship **and his** 24th overall international triumph.**
 
• Advani had earlier **defeated Pauk Sa of Myanmar **in a tough match to advance to the championship.
 
• After his opponent made a great **comeback **to **tie **the match at **four **frames apiece, he was able to** win 5-4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Geeta Sethi: **

 
 
• **​**Indian professional English billiards player Geet Siriram Sethi dominated the game for most of the **1990s.**
 
• In addition, he is a well-known **amateur (ex-pro) snooker player**.
 
• In English billiards, he has won the **world championships five times** at the professional level,** and three times** at the **amateur level**, and holds **two world records.**
 
 
 
• **Dhruv Sitwala:**
 
 
• **​​​**Dhruv Sitwala is an Indian who enjoys playing **English pool.**
 
• He has twice won the **Asian Billiards Championship **and advanced to three world finals.
 
 
 
• **Aditya Mehta:**
 
 
• **​**Aditya Mehta is an **ex-professional snooker player** from India.
 
• Between** 2011 **and **2018,** he took part in the **World Snooker Tour.**
 
• He first did so in the **2007–2008** season.
 
• His greatest position in the world rankings was **49**.
